name: com.minipayhq.minipayandroidsdk.internal.ui.LoginActivity
description: The Minipay Android SDK opens this login screen when an app requests Minipay sign-in. It asks for an email address and password, submits the login, and returns success, failure, or cancellation to the app.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in to Minipay or continue app flows that require this login.
